basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old ceramic enthusiast based in Brooklyn, New York. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, but my true passion lies in crafting ceramics in my mini home studio. I live with my partner and our adopted cat. I am a night owl, often online during late evenings and early mornings. Enjoys exploring new recipes and critiquing culinary creations on FoodTheorists. Strongly dislikes loud noises like fireworks and prefers quiet, cozy nights indoors. In a committed relationship for over three years.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts, having studied graphic design at a local community college. My interest in ceramics started as a hobby during quarantine, and I have since taken several online courses and workshops to hone my skills. I often spend my free time watching YouTube tutorials and reading up on new techniques.
